heading.en: King Noah rules in wickedness—He revels in riotous living with his wives and concubines—Abinadi prophesies that the people will be taken into bondage—His life is sought by King Noah. About 160–150 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua pule le Tupu o Noa i le amioleaga—Ua fiafia o ia i le olaga faasoesā ma ana avā ma ana palake—Ua vavalo Apinati o le a ave le nuu e fai ma pologa—Ua sailia lona ola e le Tupu o Noa. E tusa o le 160–150 T.L.M.

verses.en: And now it came to pass that Zeniff conferred the kingdom upon Noah, one of his sons; therefore Noah began to reign in his stead; and he did not walk in the ways of his father.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina faaee e Senifa le malo i luga o Noa, o se tasi o ona atalii; o lea na amata ai ona nofotupu o Noa i lona tulaga; ma sa lē savali o ia i ala o lona tamā.

w.en: in the ways of his father.

verses.en: For behold, he did not keep the command– ments of God, but he did walk after the desires of his own heart. And he had many wives and concubines. And he did cause his people to commit sin, and do that which was abominable in the sight of the Lord. Yea, and they did commit whoredoms and all manner of wicked– ness.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, sa lē tausia e ia poloaiga a le Atua, ae sa savali o ia e tusa ma manaoga o lona lava loto. Ma sa i ai ia te ia ni avā e toatele ma palake. Ma sa faia e ia ia fai e lona nuu le agasala, ma fai mea ua inosia i le silafaga a le Alii. Ioe, ma sa latou faia le faitaaga ma ituaiga o amioleaga eseese uma.

verses.en: And he laid a tax of one fifth part of all they possessed, a fifth part of their gold and of their silver, and a fifth part of their ziff, and of their copper, and of their brass and their iron; and a fifth part of their fatlings; and also a fifth part of all their grain.
verses.sm: Ma sa faatulaga e ia se lafoga o le tasi vaelima o mea uma ua latou maua, o le tasi vaelima o a latou auro ma a latou ario, ma le tasi vaelima o a latou sifa, ma a latou kopa, ma a latou apamemea, ma a latou u’amea; ma le tasi vaelima o a latou manu pepeti; ma le tasi vaelima foi o a latou saito uma.

verses.en: And all this did he take to support himself, and his wives and his concubines; and also his priests, and their wives and their concubines; thus he had changed the affairs of the kingdom.
verses.sm: Ma sa ave e ia nei mea uma e tausi ai o ia lava, ma ana avā ma ana palake; ma ana faitaulaga foi, ma a latou avā ma a latou palake; ma sa faapea ona sui e ia mataupu o le malo.

verses.en: For he put down all the priests that had been consecrated by his father, and consecrated new ones in their stead, such as were lifted up in the pride of their hearts.
verses.sm: Ona sa ia aveese faitaulaga uma na faapaia e lona tamā, ma sa ia faapaia ni faitaulaga fou e suitulaga ia i latou, e i ai i latou sa faafefeteina i le faamaualuluga o o latou loto.

verses.en: Yea, and thus they were supported in their laziness, and in their idolatry, and in their whoredoms, by the taxes which king Noah had put upon his people; thus did the people labor exceedingly to support iniquity.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma sa faapea ona lagolagoina i latou i lo latou paie, ma lo latou ifo i tupua, ma lo latou faitaaga, i lafoga na tuu e le tupu o Noa i luga o lona nuu; sa faapea ona galulue malolosi ai o le nuu e lagolago le amioletonu.

verses.en: Yea, and they also became idolatrous, because they were deceived by the vain and flattering words of the king and priests; for they did speak flattering things unto them.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma sa oo foi ina avea i latou ma tagata ifo i tupua, ona ua faasesēina i latou i upu lē aogā ma taufaasee a le tupu ma ana faitaulaga; ona sa latou tautatala atu mea taufaasee ia te i latou.

w.en: and it also came to pass

verses.en: And it came to pass that king Noah built many elegant and spacious buildings; and he ornamented them with fine work of wood, and of all manner of precious things, of gold, and of silver, and of iron, and of brass, and of ziff, and of copper;
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fausia e le tupu o Noa ni fale mata’ina ma laolao e tele; ma sa ia teuteuina i galuega taulima matagofie o laau, ma ituaiga uma o mea taugata, o le auro, ma le ario, ma le u’amea, ma le apamemea, ma le sifa, ma le kopa.

verses.en: And he also built him a spacious palace, and a throne in the midst thereof, all of which was of fine wood and was ornamented with gold and silver and with precious things.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia fausia foi se maota laolao mo ia lava, ma se nofoalii i lona totonugalemu, o nei mea uma sa fai mai i laau lelei ma sa teuteu i le auro ma le ario ma mea taugata.

verses.en: And he also caused that his workmen should work all manner of fine work within the walls of the temple, of fine wood, and of copper, and of brass.
verses.sm: Ma sa faia foi e ia ia faia e ana tagata faigaluega ituaiga uma o galuega lelei eseese i totonu o pa o le malumalu, i laau lelei, ma i le kopa, ma i le apamemea.

verses.en: And the seats which were set apart for the high priests, which were above all the other seats, he did ornament with pure gold; and he caused a breastwork to be built before them, that they might rest their bodies and their arms upon  while they should speak lying and vain words to his people.
verses.sm: Ma o nofoa sa faaagaaga mo faitaulaga sili, lea sa maualuga a’e i lo o isi nofoa uma, sa teuteu e ia i le auro mao’i; ma sa faia se si’ofatafata i o latou luma, ina ia mafai ona faalagolago i ai i luga o latou tino ma o latou lima a’o latou tautatala atu i upu pepelo ma lē aogā i lona nuu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he built a tower near the temple; yea, a very high tower, even so high that he could stand upon the top thereof and overlook the land of Shilom, and also the land of Shemlon, which was possessed by the Lamanites; and he could even look over all the land round about.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fausia e ia se ’olo latalata i le malumalu; ioe, o se ’olo maualuga lava, sa matuā maualuga tele lava sa mafai ona tu ai o ia i luga ma vaai atu i le laueleele o Seloma, ma le laueleele foi o Semulona, ia sa fai mo sa Lamanā; ma sa mafai foi ona vaai atu ai o ia i le laueleele atoa o faataamilo ai.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he caused many buildings to be built in the land Shilom; and he caused a great tower to be built on the hill north of the land Shilom, which had been a resort for the children of Nephi at the time they fled out of the land; and thus he did do with the riches which he obtained by the taxation of his people.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faia e ia ia fausia ni fale e tele i le laueleele o Seloma; ma sa faia e ia ia fausia se ’olo tele i luga o le maupu’epu’e i matu o le laueleele o Seloma, lea sa fai ma mapusaga mo le fanau a Nifae i le taimi na latou sosola ese ai mai le laueleele; ma sa faapea ona faia e ia i ’oa na ia maua mai i lafoga a lona nuu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he placed his heart upon his riches, and he spent his time in riotous living with his wives and his concubines; and so did also his priests spend their time with harlots.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina tuu atu e ia lona loto i ana ’oa, ma ia faaalu lona taimi i le olaga faasoesā faatasi ma ana avā ma ana palake; ma sa faapea foi ona faaalu e ana faitaulaga o latou taimi ma fafine talitane.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he planted vineyards round about in the land; and he built wine– presses, and made wine in abundance; and therefore he became a wine– bibber, and also his people.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina totō e ia tovine faataamilo i le laueleele; ma sa fausia e ia soli-uaina, ma faia le uaina tele; ma o lea na avea ai o ia ma se tagata inu uaina tele, ma sa faapea foi lona nuu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the Lamanites began to come in upon his people, upon small numbers, and to slay them in their fields, and while they were tending their flocks.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina amata ona o mai o sa Lamanā i luga o lona nuu, i luga o vaega toaitiiti o tagata, ma fasioti i latou i o latou fanua, a’o latou leoleo a latou lafu.

verses.en: And king Noah sent guards round about the land to keep them off; but he did not send a sufficient number, and the Lamanites came upon them and killed them, and drove many of their flocks out of the land; thus the Lamanites began to destroy them, and to exercise their hatred upon them.
verses.sm: Ma sa auina atu e le tupu o Noa leoleo faataamilo i le laueleele e tutuli ese i latou; peitai sa lē lava le toatele o e na auina atu e ia, ma sa o mai sa Lamanā ia te i latou ma fasiotia i latou, ma tutuli le tele o a latou lafu mai le laueleele; sa faapea ona amata e sa Lamanā ona faaumatia o i latou, ma faatino lo latou ita ia te i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that king Noah sent his armies against them, and they were driven back, or they drove them back for a time; therefore, they returned rejoicing in their spoil.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina auina atu e le tupu o Noa ana autau e faasagatau ia te i latou, ma sa latou solomuli, ma sa latou tutuli i latou i tua mo se taimi; o lea, na latou foi mai ai ma le olioli i mea ua latou maua.

verses.en: And now, because of this great victory they were lifted up in the pride of their hearts; they did boast in their own strength, saying that their fifty could stand against thousands of the Lamanites; and thus they did boast, and did delight in blood, and the shedding of the blood of their brethren, and this because of the wickedness of their king and priests.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ona o lenei manumalo tele, sa faafefeteina ai i latou i le faamaualuluga o o latou loto; sa latou mitamitavale i lo latou lava malosi, fai mai e mafai e la latou toalimagafulu ona tutū faasagatau atu i le afe ma afe o sa Lamanā; ma sa faapena ona latou mitamitavale, ma fiafia i le toto, ma le faamasaaina o le toto o o latou uso, ma o lenei ona o le amioleaga o lo latou tupu ma o latou faitaulaga.

verses.en: And it came to pass that there was a man among them whose name was Abinadi; and he went forth among them, and began to prophesy, saying: Behold, thus saith the Lord, and thus hath he commanded me, saying, Go forth, and say unto this people, thus saith the Lord—Wo be unto this people, for I have seen their abominations, and their wickedness, and their whoredoms; and except they repent I will visit them in mine anger.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina sa i ai faatasi ma i latou se tagata o lona igoa o Apinati; ma sa alu atu o ia i totonu o i latou, ma amata ona vavalo, fai mai: Faauta, ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii, ma ua faapea ona ia poloaiina o a’u, e faapea, Alu atu ia, ma fai atu i lenei nuu, ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii— Oi talofa i lenei nuu, ona ua Ou vaai ia latou mea inosia, ma a latou amioleaga, ma a latou faitaaga; ma o le a Ou asiasi atu ia te i latou i lo’u toasa, vaganā ai ua latou salamo.

verses.en: And except they repent and turn to the Lord their God, behold, I will deliver them into the hands of their enemies; yea, and they shall be brought into bondage; and they shall be afflicted by the hand of their enemies.
verses.sm: Ma e vaganā ai ua latou salamo ma liliu mai i le Alii lo latou Atua, faauta, o le a ou tuuina atu i latou i lima o o latou fili; ioe, ma o le a aumai i latou i le pologa; ma o le a faapuapuagatiaina i latou i lima o o latou fili.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that they shall know that I am the Lord their God, and am a jealous God, visiting the iniquities of my people.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai, o le a latou iloa o A’u o le Alii lo latou Atua, ma o A’u o se Atua fuā, e asiasi atu i lo’u nuu i a latou amioletonu.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that except this people repent and turn unto the Lord their God, they shall be brought into bondage; and none shall deliver them, except it be the Lord the Almighty God.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai, se’i vagana ua salamo lenei nuu ma liliu mai i le Alii lo latou Atua, o le a aumai i latou e nofo pologa; ma o le a leai se tasi e lavea’i ia i latou, vaganā ai lava le Alii le Atua Silisiliese.

verses.en: Yea, and it shall come to pass that when they shall cry unto me I will be slow to hear their cries; yea, and I will suffer them that they be smitten by their enemies.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma o le a oo pe a latou tagi mai ia te a’u o le a faagesegese ona Ou faalogo atu ia latou tagi; ioe, ma o le a Ou tuu i latou ina ia taia i latou e o latou fili.

w.en: and it shall come to pass

verses.en: And except they repent in sackcloth and ashes, and cry mightily to the Lord their God, I will not hear their prayers, neither will I deliver them out of their afflictions; and thus saith the Lord, and thus hath he commanded me.
verses.sm: Ma vagana ai ua latou salamo i le ofu o le ie talatala ma le lefulefu, ma tagi faatauanau mai i le Alii lo latou Atua, o le a Ou lē lagona a latou tatalo, pe Ou te lavea’i i latou mai o latou puapuaga; ma ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii, ma ua faapea ona ia poloaiina o a’u.

verses.en: Now it came to pass that when Abinadi had spoken these words unto them they were wroth with him, and sought to take away his life; but the Lord delivered him out of their hands.
verses.sm: O lenei sa oo ina ua uma ona tautala atu Apinati i nei upu ia te i latou, sa latou feitai ia te ia, ma saili e aveese lona ola; peitai sa laveaiina o ia e le Alii mai o latou lima.

verses.en: Now when king Noah had heard of the words which Abinadi had spoken unto the people, he was also wroth; and he said: Who is Abinadi, that I and my people should be judged of him, or who is the Lord, that shall bring upon my people such great affliction?
verses.sm: O lenei ina ua faalogo le tupu o Noa i upu na tautala atu e Apinati i le nuu, sa ita foi o ia, ma sa ia fai mai: O ai Apinati, ua ia faamasinoina ai a’u ma lo’u nuu, po o ai foi le Alii, o le a aumaia i luga o lo’u nuu le puapuaga tele faapea?

verses.en: I command you to bring Abinadi hither, that I may slay him, for he has said these things that he might stir up my people to anger one with another, and to raise contentions among my people; therefore I will slay him.
verses.sm: Ou te poloai atu ia te outou ia aumai Apinati iinei, ina ia mafai ona ou fasioti ia te ia, ona ua fai mai e ia nei mea ia mafai ona faaoso ai e ia lo’u nuu ia ita le tasi i le isi, ma faatutupu ai finauga i totonu o lo’u nuu; o lea o le a ou fasiotia ai o ia.

verses.en: Now the eyes of the people were blinded; therefore they hardened their hearts against the words of Abinadi, and they sought from that time forward to take him. And king Noah hardened his heart against the word of the Lord, and he did not repent of his evil doings.
verses.sm: O lenei sa faatauasoina mata o le nuu; o lea sa latou faamaaa ai o latou loto e faasaga i upu a Apinati, ma sa latou saili mai lena taimi e pu’e o ia. Ma sa faamaaa e le tupu o Noa lona loto e faasaga i le afioga a le Alii, ma sa lē salamo o ia i ana mea leaga.
